title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program Fitting Rules: Item Compatibility With the Recorded Equipment
content:
**General rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program items must fit the equipment recorded on the enrollment.

## Interface style and the items it receives

| Recorded interface style | Interface item | Cushion item | Chinstrap (A7036) |
|---|---|---|---|
| full face | full face mask (A7030) | full face mask cushion (A7031) | not shipped |
| nasal | nasal interface (A7034) | nasal mask cushion (A7032) | may ship |
| nasal pillows | nasal interface (A7034) | nasal pillows pair (A7033) | may ship |

A7036 ships only to nasal and nasal pillows patients.

## Tubing

Where the schedule makes heated and standard tubing mutually exclusive, heated tubing (A4604) and standard tubing (A7037) never both ship inside one tubing period, and whether heated tubing is in use on the enrollment decides which one ships.

| Heated tubing in use on the enrollment | Tubing that ships, where the two are mutually exclusive |
|---|---|
| yes | heated tubing (A4604) |
| no | standard tubing (A7037) |

## Water chamber

Where the schedule ships a water chamber only to a patient using a heated humidifier, A7046 ships only when the enrollment records a humidifier in use.

## Change of interface style

Where the schedule restricts a change of interface style, an interface of a different style shipped before the covered-through date of the enrollment's last interface line is not billed to coverage (the patient may buy it self-pay), unless it is the no-charge mask-fit exchange the program's replacement rules allow. The last interface line is the most recent shipped line of a full face mask (A7030) or a nasal interface (A7034) on the enrollment up to the handling date, leaving out any line a payer has taken back; its item, ship date and covered-through date are what the rule reads.

A change of style is recorded as a preference update before items of the new style ship.

## Points of judgement

- **Nasal pillows patient.** Receives the nasal interface A7034 and pillow pairs A7033, and may receive a chinstrap.
- **Full face patient.** Receives A7030 and A7031 and is not shipped a chinstrap.
- **Different style inside the period (restriction on).** An interface of another style shipped before the last interface line's covered-through date is not billed to coverage, except for the fit exchange; the patient may buy it self-pay.
